response.justification: The candidate is a versatile, experienced generalist with nearly 20 years in software development, some low-latency distributed systems work (DLang microservices handling millions of requests/sec), and demonstrated mentoring through workshops and courses. However, he falls well short of the core minimum qualification of 8 years of C++ experience (only ~6 months of professional C/C++ at National Instruments plus a thesis project), has limited large-scale cloud compute/infrastructure depth, and lacks formal technical-leadership experience managing cross-team priorities and deliverables. His recent work is predominantly full-stack TypeScript/Node.js product engineering, which is a poor match for a C++-centric cloud compute platform lead role.
strengths: High-throughput, low-latency systems experience (async I/O, fibers, caching) at Dunnhumby/Sociomantic
Strong engineering-practice advocate: TDD, CI/CD, pairing, trunk-based development, testing tooling author
Proven mentor and knowledge-sharer via workshops, courses, and open-source leadership (GISCollective founder)
concerns: Far below the required 8 years of C++ experience; recent stack is TypeScript/Node.js
No formal technical-leadership role leading strategy, priorities, and cross-team alignment
Limited production cloud compute/infrastructure architecture experience at large scale
